data.description: 【圣园未花 · 钟楼顶端的清风】古老钟楼的最顶层，轻柔的微风吹拂着未花的纯白礼服与粉色长发。她倚着石雕护栏俯瞰着下方的学园，回过头对你展颜一笑——「从这里看下去景色超棒对吧？但是对我来说……能和老师一起站在这里，才是最棒的奇迹哦。」
data.promptProse: Mika leans against the old clocktower's carved stone balustrade, looking over the academy before turning back with a bright smile. Her pastel-pink sundress and loosely draped ivory cardigan move with her long pink hair. The low wide view includes tower mechanisms behind and the campus below. Sunset edges the cardigan and stone carvings, with mechanical shadows crossing the interior floor farther from the opening.
data.title: 圣园未花 · 钟楼顶端的清风
